summary.text: You can use MediSave for vaccine costs after subsidies at CHAS clinics and polyclinics, if the clinic allows it.

details.heading: Where you can use it
details.body: You can use MediSave to cover the out-of-pocket expense at CHAS GP clinics and polyclinics.

steps.name: Check at clinic
steps.text: Check with your preferred clinic if the clinic is able to process the remaining co-payment via MediSave.

steps.name: Confirm eligibility
steps.text: If they do, please check with them on your eligibility to pay via MediSave.

example_phrasings: Can MediSave be used for the co-payment after subsidy for vaccinations?
Can I use MediSave to pay for my vaccine co-payment?
Can MediSave cover vaccine out-of-pocket costs?

sources.page_title: Can MediSave be used for the co-payment after subsidy for vaccinations?

quotes.text: Those eligible for subsidised vaccination may also use their MediSave to cover the out-of-pocket expense at CHAS GP clinics and polyclinics.
Please check with your preferred clinic if the clinic is able to process the remaining co-payment via MediSave.
If they do, please check with them on your eligibility to pay via MediSave.
